resolution: Answered the user's render-resolution question from source: NO 360p-and-stretch anywhere. The editor's Scene3D viewport renders offscreen at the node's exact layout size 1:1 (gpu/3d.zig render() acquireRt(w,h)) and the swapchain is configured at the SDL window size (gpu.zig:2063), so editor measurements are true native-resolution costs on the 2K display. The kernel of truth: the standalone no-V8 loader (rjit game play) opens a hardcoded, non-resizable 800x600 window (world_loader.zig:51 WIN_W/WIN_H, flags=0) rendered 1:1 — a genuinely small window, not a stretched low-res buffer. Noted that triangle-rate walls measured earlier are resolution-independent while fill cost scales with window pixels. Answer only; offered (not implemented) making the loader window sized/resizable.
